page_title: Trina AX: Claude Code and Codex for your whole team

sources.entry: Trina AX - Team AI workspace with one shared drive, chat rooms and per-person folder permissions, on your own server. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/trina-app/trina-ax) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Trina AX
summary.one_liner: Trina AX is an open-source team AI workspace where a shared drive, chat rooms, and written team skills let everyone's AI assistant work the same way.
use_cases: Automating customer quotes from a price sheet
Sharing company files and procedures with a whole team
Asking an AI assistant inside a team chat room and sharing the answer
Keeping team folders with per-person access permissions
Standardizing how team members use AI for recurring tasks
summary.what_it_does: The team lead uploads company files into a shared drive organized into folders such as Sales and Finance, and writes down procedures as skills. The page states it reads PDF, Office, HWP and image files. A skill is a written instruction file (for example SKILL.md) that everyone's AI follows, such as a customer quote procedure that reads the price sheet, applies a volume discount, and produces a PDF quote. Users can ask the AI beside any team conversation and send the answer to the room. The page says it is open source and can run on your own server, with per-person folder permissions.
notable: Team skills written once (SKILL.md files) that apply to everyone's AI
Shared drive plus chat rooms where AI answers can be sent to the team
Per-person folder permissions on your own server
Reads PDF, Office, HWP and image files
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform support beyond running on your own server is not stated
